notes: PR135 creates a separate enriched example and does not modify the original rendered brief.

enrichment_scope.scope: Add one plain-language interpretation section to one existing rendered brief.
enrichment_scope.plain_language_requirement: The enriched brief should explain what may already have been present, what appears to have been sharpened, and what remains uncertain without exposing field/status machinery.

fields_used.how_used: Rephrased the decision as public enterprise beta versus constrained private enterprise proof.
Included only as a visible uncertainty that the starting direction may already have leaned away from simple public launch.
Used to clarify the action consequence: same paid scoped private-pilot offer for both prospects and buyer behavior as evidence.
Used as visible thresholds: paid commitment, scoped workflow, capped support, audit-log boundary, conversion trigger, reference terms, and tripwires.
Used to show that buyer behavior, procurement clarity, scope tolerance, and named public-launch outcomes become the proof points.
Used only as a descriptive read: the process appears to have sharpened attention from logo optics toward proof-producing buyer behavior and stop rules.
Used to preserve the non-proof boundary in the enriched brief.

Excluded because the read cannot safely distinguish rejected, deferred, narrowed, or still-live paths.
Excluded from the user-facing body because it could read as unsupported criticism of the revised answer.
Excluded because PR131 and PR134 mark lost value as insufficient context.
Not selected for the tiny read and requires richer context or human review.
Not selected for the tiny read and only partially visible in checked-in-safe summaries.

expected_reader_value.plain_language_read: The enriched section should help a reader see the distinction between a direction that may already have been present and the narrower action consequence the audit appears to have sharpened.
expected_reader_value.decision_story_value: It makes the value of the process more concrete: the decision is less about launch optics and more about proof-producing buyer behavior under explicit constraints.
expected_reader_value.why_not_a_field_dump: The enriched Markdown uses one short story section rather than listing PR128 field names or statuses in the main body.
expected_reader_value.what_a_busy_reader_should_get: A busy reader should understand why the private-pilot recommendation is not merely caution; it is tied to thresholds, evidence gates, and stop rules.

risks.source_depth_risk: The enrichment still relies on checked-in-safe summaries and one provisional interpretation read; raw conversation, revised answer, memo, provider text, and private ledgers are not checked in.
risks.overclaim_risk: The enriched prose could over-credit Lolla if it implies the audit caused every part of the private-pilot direction.
risks.reader_confidence_risk: Cleaner prose can make provisional interpretation feel more settled than it is.
risks.field_leakage_risk: If future enrichment exposes field names or source-status vocabulary in the main body, the brief will regress into machinery.
risks.quality_label_risk: Useful friction is included only as a descriptive read and must not become answer-quality scoring.

decision_gate.rationale: The enriched brief is coherent enough to compare against the original. It adds one plain-language interpretation section, preserves uncertainty and non-claims, and does not modify runtime or the original brief.
